name: returns the longest recent suffix within the budget
input: three messages totaling two, one, and two tokens
test:
history = ConversationHistory()
history.add('user', 'one two')
history.add('assistant', 'three')
history.add('user', 'four five')
assert history.get_recent(3) == [('assistant', 'three'), ('user', 'four five')]
assert history.get_recent(2) == [('user', 'four five')]
assert history.get_recent(1) == []

name: keeps zero-token whitespace messages in a valid suffix
input: whitespace-only content after a budget-exceeding message
test:
history = ConversationHistory()
history.add('user', 'one')
history.add('assistant', '   \t ')
assert history.get_recent(0) == [('assistant', '   \t ')]
assert history.get_recent(10) == [('user', 'one'), ('assistant', '   \t ')]
